definitions.explanation: An automated gate at train and subway stations that reads tickets or IC cards to allow passengers through. A ubiquitous feature of Japanese public transportation.

examples.japanese: {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: I pass through the ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ICカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自動改札|じどうかいさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タッチ→タッチ：08915_tacchi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I tapped my IC card on the automatic ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自動改札|じどうかいさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかって→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧しまい、⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: My ticket got stuck in the automatic gate, so I called a station attendant.

notes:
{自動改札|じどうかいさつ} is the automatic ticket gate found at train and subway stations. Composed of ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧ (automatic) + ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧ (ticket inspection/gate).

FULL FORM:
The official name is ⟦{自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}→自動改札機：16261_jidoukaisatsuki⟧ (automatic ticket gate machine), but {自動改札|じどうかいさつ} is the standard short form.

HOW IT WORKS:
- Insert a paper ticket into the slot, or tap an IC card on the reader
- The gate opens if the fare is valid
- IC cards (Suica, PASMO, ICOCA, etc.) are now the most common method

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass through the ticket gate
- {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タッチ→タッチ：08915_tacchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tap on the gate
- {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っかかる→引っかかる：12455_hikkakaru⟧: to get caught/stuck at the gate

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{改札口|かいさつぐち}→改札口：09552_kaisatsuguchi⟧: ticket gate area/entrance
- {有人改札|ゆうじんかいさつ}: staffed ticket gate (for special cases)
